title: Privacy Policy
description: How Busaty collects, uses, and protects data, plus your available rights.

hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.subtitle: We explain what we collect, why we collect it, and how you can exercise your rights.

items.body: What we collect and why: user-provided data plus automatic data (e.g., location/device) to enable tracking and improve service.
Legal basis: operating the service, compliance, and experience improvement.
Retention & deletion: keep only what is needed, then delete or anonymize per policy.
Your rights: access, rectification, deletion, or restriction as allowed by law.
